💡 The novelty lies in using recycled H₃PO₄ to leach biomass, creating hierarchically confined micropores (0.86–2 nm) with P/O functional groups that act as catalytic desolvation sites. Significance: a green, sustainable route enabling high-capacity, high-energy-density ZIHCs with exceptional 50,000-cycle stability.

Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in synergistically combining Friedel-Crafts acylation with Zn²⁺ coordination anchoring to suppress pitch graphitization and engineer hierarchical pores. This dual strategy creates high-density ultramicropores and closed pores, enabling a hard carbon anode with 364.81 mAh g⁻¹ capacity, 90.73% initial Coulombic efficiency, and excellent rate performance—offering a universal route to upgrade low-cost pitch into high-performance sodium-ion battery anodes.

الاژیک اسید به‌عنوان پل مولکولی در الکترولیت PEO، شبکه پیوند هیدروژنی و شیمی هماهنگی Li+ را بهبود می‌دهد و عمر باتری حالت جامد Li|LFP را افزایش می‌دهد.
ACS Nano | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Ellagic acid serves as a novel "molecule bridge" in PEO electrolytes, simultaneously stabilizing the hydrogen-bond network and tuning Li+ coordination. This integrated design weakens PEO–Li+ chelation, enriches TFSI– and EA in the solvation sheath, and forms a robust LiF/Li3N/PhOLi-rich SEI. It enables 3500-cycle Li|LFP stability and practical pouch-cell operation, offering a significant supramolecular strategy for long-life solid-state batteries.
🏷 solid-state battery · PEO electrolyte · hydrogen bonding · ellagic acid · Li+ coordination
